mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDPC1 above its 3-month moving average triggers expectations of robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not statistically positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 crossing threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 exceeds INDPRO, signaling excess demand relative to supply, investors anticipate inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > INDPRO in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite consistent GDPC1 > INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 8% triggers expectations of weakening labor markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS coupled with a simultaneous drop in UNRATE signals a tightening labor market and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases while UNRATE falls in the same month
regime_hint: tightening labor market and policy accommodation
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous increases in INDPRO (supply) and PAYEMS (labor) signal robust growth, prompting positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and PAYEMS both increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the simultaneous rise in INDPRO and PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below its 3-month moving average indicates improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or UNRATE shows no sustained decline over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% triggers expectations of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing threshold.
